chunks: Remember, O children of Israel, the favours I bestowed on you, and made you exalted among the nations of the world.
ai.seo_question: What specific favor did God bestow upon the Children of Israel in Surah Al-Baqarah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to the specific prophetic lineage and spiritual superiority granted to the Children of Israel during the era of the Prophet Muhammad, particularly through the Imams. It serves as a reminder of their covenantal duty to uphold divine law, while also foreshadowing the transfer of this leadership to the Ahl al-Bayt, who are considered the true inheritors of this spiritual favor.
